decisions.reason: As a close extension of the established drainage range in a growing market, this design variant is likely to stay because results probably meet a modest aspiration level and the firm has enough slack to carry it, even if its weaker website prominence suggests some uncertainty.

A shower channel for seamless coverings fits the firm’s core offer and was given its own product page, which signals commitment and likely satisfactory early feedback, reducing the incentive for problemistic search.

Although this pump-assisted solution is related to the core business, it is more specialized and technically uncertain, so its aspiration threshold may be harder to meet, but the firm’s broad range, R&D capability, and slack still make retention more likely than withdrawal.

This tileable floor drain is very close to the firm’s existing competencies and its dedicated web presence suggests acceptable early market reception, so management would likely keep it absent clear underperformance.

A stainless steel design grate matches the firm’s design-and-engineering positioning and broad product portfolio, and with no sign of poor results there is little reason to drop it within the next year.
